transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, I guess I came in because... well, for a long time now, I just wake up already feeling low. It's like there's this heavy, gray feeling on me before I even get to the clinic for work, and it pretty much just follows me through the whole day.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about two years and two months. It started right around the time the staffing changed at the clinic, and they put me on this rotating schedule that's just all over the place.
During these past two years, has there been any period of two months or more where you felt like your normal self?
No, um... not really. I don't think there's been any break that long. It's just been pretty much constant this whole time.
Before this started two years ago, had you ever experienced any other episodes of depression in your life?

No, um... I don't think so. Before all this started a couple of years ago, I felt pretty normal. I definitely didn't feel this heavy back in high school or anything. It really just seemed to start when things got so chaotic at work, and I haven't been able to shake it since.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy doing?
No, um... I don't think so. I still enjoy the things I usually like to do. I haven't really noticed losing interest in my hobbies or anything like that.
Have you been experiencing low energy or feeling unusually tired during this time?

Yeah, I have. Even after a day off or sleeping late, my body still just feels completely worn out. By the time I finish rooming patients at work and catching up on all the charts, it feels like I have absolutely nothing left in the tank. I don't even have the energy to do my laundry, shoot hoops, or, you know, mess with my electronics stuff when I get home.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like having trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

No, my sleep is actually pretty normal. I don't have any trouble falling asleep, and I usually sleep through the night just fine. I'm not really sleeping more than usual either... I just get my regular eight hours or so. It's just that, like I was saying, it doesn't really seem to make a dent in how tired I feel during the day.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits over this time?
No, not really. My appetite's been about the same as always. I haven't been eating more or less than usual, and I haven't noticed any weight changes either. I just eat my regular meals.
How have you been feeling about yourself lately, such as your self-confidence or self-worth?

I guess I feel alright about myself. I haven't really noticed any big changes in my self-confidence or anything like that. I mean, I don't feel great because I'm always so tired, but I don't feel bad about who I am or anything. I'm just kind of... me, you know? It's just the energy thing that's really getting to me.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, staying focused, or making decisions lately?

Yeah, actually. It's been pretty bad at work lately. I'm a medical assistant, so I do a lot of patient intakes. But lately, I'll be staring at a patient's screen and I just have to reread the same line over and over again because it's not registering. And I've caught myself missing little details, like medication doses, or I'll just completely mix up what I was about to ask the patient next. It's just hard to stay focused on what I'm doing.
